reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing guard pattern (link.ensureAccountNotLinked) with a sibling ensureAccountIsOpen in the same module and uses db.first like its neighbour.

duplication.why: The rule itself is written once; only the one-line guard call is repeated across the six provider link functions, mirroring how ensureAccountNotLinked is already called.

placement.why: The guard sits in server/accounts/link.ts next to the other link-precondition helper and is invoked at the top of each link handler before any side effect.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and consistent with existing code; a new provider still has to remember to call both guards, and the helper re-reads the account row each handler loads anyway.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared guard

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpen in server/accounts/link.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkEnableBankingAccount and linkFintegraAccount
